symptoms.job_failed: The Job finished with a failure.
symptoms.cronjob_not_scheduling: The CronJob is not starting Jobs on its schedule.

facts.job_backoff_limit_exceeded: Job {job} was marked failed after {failed} failed Pods, which reached its retry limit of {limit}.
facts.job_deadline_exceeded: Job {job} was marked failed because it ran longer than its time limit (spec.activeDeadlineSeconds).
facts.job_suspended: Job {job} is suspended (spec.suspend); this is a state you set, not a failure.
facts.cronjob_missed_runs: CronJob {cronjob} should have started {missed} time(s) since {since}, but no Job was created.
facts.cronjob_starting_deadline: CronJob {cronjob} may start a run at most {seconds} s late (spec.startingDeadlineSeconds); later runs are skipped.
facts.cronjob_active_job_blocking: Job {job} of CronJob {cronjob} has been running since {since}, longer than the schedule interval; {skipped} run(s) were skipped.

hypotheses.job_backoff_limit_exceeded: Job {job} used up its retries: its Pods kept failing until the retry limit was reached, so Kubernetes stopped it.
hypotheses.job_deadline_exceeded: Job {job} did not finish within its time limit, so Kubernetes stopped it.
hypotheses.cronjob_suspended: CronJob {cronjob} is suspended, so about {missed} scheduled run(s) did not start.
hypotheses.cronjob_missed_schedule: CronJob {cronjob} missed scheduled runs: Jobs were not created in time, so the runs were skipped.
hypotheses.cronjob_concurrency_blocked: Job {job} is still running, and CronJob {cronjob} forbids concurrent runs, so {skipped} scheduled run(s) were skipped.

recommendations.rec_fix_job_pod_failures: Find out why the Pods of Job {job} fail (see their own findings) and fix that cause first.
recommendations.rec_raise_job_backoff_limit: If the failures are expected and temporary, raise spec.backoffLimit of Job {job} (now {limit}).
recommendations.rec_raise_job_deadline: If the work legitimately needs more time, raise spec.activeDeadlineSeconds of Job {job}.
recommendations.rec_resume_cronjob: Resume CronJob {cronjob} (set spec.suspend to false) if the schedule should run, or leave it suspended on purpose.
recommendations.rec_fix_blocking_job: Find out why Job {job} does not finish and fix or stop it; or change spec.concurrencyPolicy of CronJob {cronjob} to Replace or Allow.
recommendations.rec_check_cronjob_controller: Check that the cluster's controller manager is healthy and that node clocks are in sync; read the events of CronJob {cronjob}.
recommendations.rec_review_starting_deadline: Review spec.startingDeadlineSeconds of CronJob {cronjob}: a short deadline makes every delayed run be skipped.

steps.step_check_job_pods: Open the Pods of Job {job} and read their last state and events. Pods may already be deleted by the retention policy.
steps.step_check_cronjob_events: Read the events of CronJob {cronjob} for the reasons the controller gives for skipped runs.

missing.job_pods_not_retained: No Pods of Job {job} remain in the cluster, so the reason they failed cannot be shown. They may have been deleted by the retention policy.
missing.job_history_truncated: Job {job} has more Pods than the report keeps; only the newest are shown, so older failures are not analyzed.
missing.job_failure_reason_unrecognized: Job {job} failed for a reason that Kubron does not analyze yet.
missing.cronjob_history_truncated: CronJob {cronjob} has more Jobs than the report keeps; only the newest are shown, so older runs are not analyzed.
missing.cronjob_schedule_unreadable: The schedule or time zone of CronJob {cronjob} could not be parsed, so missed runs cannot be counted.
